jobs.title: Senior Creative Operations Lead, Brand
jobs.description:
THUMBTACK HELPS MILLIONS OF PEOPLE CONFIDENTLY CARE FOR THEIR HOMES.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.


ABOUT THE BRAND MARKETING TEAM

We’re a tight-knit, collaborative group on a mission to make Thumbtack famous. The Thumbtack brand marketing team exists to reimagine brand building, using modern marketing tools to drive preference and brand recognition. We are tasked with creating a category-defining, differentiated brand and bringing it to life consistently across multiple media touchpoints to drive brand recognition and commercial success.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Brand Operations Specialist to build and lead the operational foundation of the Brand organization at Thumbtack. This is the launch of a new discipline—and this person will define it from the ground up.

This role is responsible for developing the systems, workflows, tooling, automations, and governance models that allow the Brand team to scale with clarity, consistency, and high creative standards. A core requirement of this role is advanced, hands-on use and application of AI—not as a supplement to the work, but as a primary method for building smart systems, automating repetitive tasks, and enabling the organization to operate at a higher level. This person will partner closely with technical teams to scope, author, and maintain the processes and tooling that form the Brand team's operational model.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, systems thinker, and AI practitioner. They are energized by building order from complexity, and they understand that strong processes are a strategic enabler of better creative outcomes—not administrative overhead.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build the Brand Operations discipline from the ground up, establishing the systems, standards, and practices that support scalable, high-performing brand work.

 - Design and implement operational workflows that improve visibility, prioritization, intake, approvals, handoffs, timelines, and overall process hygiene across the Brand team.

 - Partner with technical teams to scope, author, and maintain the processes, automations, and tooling that form the Brand operational model.

 - Apply advanced AI capabilities to automate manual tasks, build intelligent workflows, and create scalable systems—this is a core job function, not an optional enhancement.

 - Evaluate, implement, and continuously optimize tools that support project management, asset workflows, collaboration, review cycles, and team planning.

 - Establish frameworks for how AI should be applied across Brand operations, ensuring adoption is practical, measurable, and aligned with team goals.

 - Author, document, and manage team processes so they are clear, repeatable, and easy for cross-functional partners to adopt and follow.

 - Partner closely with producers, brand managers, art directors, and technical teams to ensure operating models support both creative excellence and executional clarity.

 - Track operational performance and identify opportunities to improve throughput, reduce friction, and increase organizational effectiveness.

 - Serve as the central owner of Brand team process clarity, ensuring roles, responsibilities, timelines, and decision-making pathways are well understood across the organization.




IN ORDER TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU MUST BRING

 - Experience in brand operations, creative operations, program management, or workflow design, ideally within an in-house brand, marketing, or creative organization.

 - Advanced, hands-on experience applying AI tools and automation to real operational workflows—this is a required skill, not a nice-to-have.

 - Proven ability to partner with technical teams to scope, design, and implement process and tooling solutions at scale.

 - Strong operational instincts, with the ability to translate ambiguity into clear processes, documentation, and working models.

 - Experience assessing and managing tools that support collaboration, project tracking, production, review, or creative workflow management.

 - Excellent judgment about when process adds value and when it creates unnecessary friction.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build clarity, alignment, and accountability across a diverse set of stakeholders.

 - A systems mindset and a high bar for organization, documentation, and continuous improvement.

 - Availability to operate on or closely aligned with PST hours for real-time cross-functional collaboration.

 - Experience standing up a new operational function or discipline within a growing organization.

 - Familiarity with AI-enabled workflow tools, knowledge management systems, process automation platforms, or creative operations tooling.

 - Experience supporting brand, design, or marketing teams with complex stakeholder environments and multiple concurrent workstreams.

 - Ability to define success metrics and measure the impact of operational improvements over time.

 - Experience developing governance models, team rituals, intake systems, or process documentation at scale.

jobs.title: Corporate FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
THUMBTACK HELPS MILLIONS OF PEOPLE CONFIDENTLY CARE FOR THEIR HOMES.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.


ABOUT THE FINANCE TEAM

Thumbtack’s Finance team is the trusted steward of the company’s resources and a genuine partner to the business. We do not just report the numbers; we help decide where the next dollar goes. Corporate FP&A sits at the center of that work, owning the consolidated forecast, the annual plan, and the reporting that leadership and our Board rely on. We are also rebuilding how finance work gets done, using AI to take the manual grind out of reporting so the team can spend its time on judgment instead of assembly. It is a small, high-trust team with unusually direct access to the decisions that shape the company.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Corporate FP&A Manager, you will own the consolidated view of Thumbtack’s P&L — the forecast, the annual plan, and the reporting that goes to our leadership team and Board. This is a high-scope individual contributor role with direct exposure to the CFO and the Finance leadership team. You will also help rebuild how the work gets done: we are actively replacing manual FP&A processes with AI-assisted workflows, and we want someone who is excited to lead that, not just tolerate it. If you want to sit close to the decisions and help build a finance function that is ready for the next stage of the company, this is that seat.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the consolidated monthly and quarterly P&L close process for FP&A, including forecasting, variance analysis, and the narrative that explains what actually happened

 - Run the annual budgeting cycle end to end, from bottoms-up build through executive review

 - Build management and Board-level reporting, including Board decks, quarterly outlooks, and analysis that supports investor conversations

 - Apply AI and workflow automation to core FP&A processes, replacing manual reporting and reconciliation work with something faster and more reliable

 - Collaborate across Business Finance, Strategic Finance, Accounting, and Business Analytics to keep one consistent view of the numbers

 - Lead ad hoc analyses and scenario modeling for the CFO and the leadership team on the questions that matter most that quarter

 - Partner closely with Revenue Forecasting and serve as backup on the revenue and funnel forecast, including the weekly outlook and revenue flash

 


IN ORDER TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU MUST BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting, with meaningful time spent in a corporate or consolidated finance function

 - Excellent financial modeling skills in Excel and Google Sheets, with the judgment to know when a model should be simple and when it should not

 - Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to real finance workflows, and a point of view on where they help and where they do not

 - A track record of building management and Board-level reporting, including the written narrative that goes with the numbers

 - Strong written and verbal communication, with experience presenting to senior executives

 - Hands-on experience with EPM and ERP systems such as Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, Pigment, Aleph, Oracle Planning & Business Systems, NetSuite, SAP

 - Comfort querying data directly - SQL or equivalent - enough to validate revenue forecasting and funnel inputs without a handoff

 


EXPECTED SALARY RANGES

 - For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected salary range for the role is currently $161,500.00 - $209,000.00.

 - For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected salary range for the role is currently $145,400.00 - $188,100.00.

 - For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected salary range for this role is currently $137,700.00 - $178,200.00.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Vendor and Scaled Operations
jobs.description:
THUMBTACK HELPS MILLIONS OF PEOPLE CONFIDENTLY CARE FOR THEIR HOMES.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.


ABOUT THE SERVICE OPERATIONS TEAM

We're a tight-knit team of program management, process & automation, and workforce management professionals working together to deliver world-class service through operational excellence and strategic enablement. We collaborate closely with frontline Service, Business Apps, QA, Enablement, and Analytics teams to plan and deliver on complex initiatives that improve processes, tools, and how our service operates day-to-day. Our focus is on creating service experiences that are both efficient for our operations team while providing an excellent experience for our customers and pros.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Program Manager, Vendor & Scaled Operations within Thumbtack's Service Operations PMO, you will own our outsourced and scaled delivery model - the strategy, the governance, and the long-horizon programs that determine how a meaningful share of our service gets delivered. This is not a generalist PM role. It is purpose-built for someone who can hold a commercial relationship, an operational system, and an executive narrative at the same time.

You will own Thumbtack's vendor and BPO strategy for Service Operations end to end: how we decide what to outsource, how we hold partners accountable, how we govern performance, and how we scale or unwind capacity as the business changes. You'll own a portfolio of scaled operations and partner support programs spanning a year or more, with real interdependencies between them, and you'll make the prioritization and capacity calls across that portfolio rather than escalating them.

You'll also be the person leadership turns to for the make-versus-buy conversation. Expect to build the cost, quality, and risk case for how we scale, bring it to senior leaders and to vendor executives, and then be accountable for the model you recommended.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. Much of the infrastructure you'll need does not fully exist yet, and building it durably - so it outlasts you - is a core part of the job.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own Thumbtack's vendor and outsourcing strategy for Service Operations - sourcing decisions, make-versus-buy recommendations, capacity strategy across internal, vendor, and partner channels, and the case for expanding, consolidating, or exiting a partner. Own the commercial relationship alongside Legal, Finance, and Procurement (SOWs, rate structures, SLA credits and remedies, renewals) and know which levers to pull when performance slips.

 - Design and optimize the governance model for vendor performance: SLA and scorecard architecture, QBR structure, decision rights, escalation paths, and remediation playbooks. Build durable frameworks, not one-off trackers.

 - Own a portfolio of programs. Set the strategy, sequence the work, decide what does and doesn't get done, drive it to business-level outcomes, and establish the operating rhythms - cadences, decision logs, dependency tracking, escalation thresholds, change communication - that keep distributed, multi-party delivery predictable.

 - Build the measurement framework for the scaled delivery model: quality, SLA attainment, forecast accuracy, cost-to-serve, and the leading indicators that reveal a program is silently degrading before the lagging metrics do. Define what "good" looks like and close the loop so performance data actually changes behavior - on our side and the vendor's.

 - Align senior leaders and lead the change. Bring executives across Service Operations, IT, Legal, Finance, Product, and Workforce Management to a decision on sourcing priorities and tradeoffs, translating tangled multi-party problems into a clear recommendation - then drive adoption through teams and partners who don't report to you, including the unglamorous follow-through that determines whether change sticks.

 - Raise the bar on how this work gets done. Identify and build AI and automation that reduces coordination overhead and improves oversight at scale, and coach other program managers while institutionalizing what works into playbooks and standards, so every future partnership starts from a higher floor.

 


IN ORDER TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU MUST BRING

 - 8+ years in program or project management, including 3+ years owning vendor, BPO, or outsourced delivery relationships at scale. Experience with multiple vendors, multiple sites, or a vendor transition is strongly preferred. Proficiency in program management tooling (e.g., Jira, Linear, Coda, Smartsheet) and fluency across Agile and Waterfall approaches. PMP, PgMP, or equivalent is nice-to-have.

 - Deep vendor ownership and sourcing judgment. You've personally owned an outsourcing relationship end to end - commercial terms, governance, performance management, escalation, and the hard conversations - not just coordinated with one someone else owned. You've also built and defended a make-versus-buy or vendor expansion case with cost, quality, and risk modeling, and taken it to senior leadership.

 - Portfolio-level ownership. You've run multiple concurrent scale programs with genuine tradeoffs between them, and owned the prioritization and capacity calls yourself. You've run programs where consistency of human execution at volume is the product - you know how to design for repeatability, and you spot degradation from leading indicators rather than after the fact.

 - A track record of building durable infrastructure. SLA and scorecard architecture, governance models, transition playbooks, reporting systems - things other teams adopted and still use. You build and maintain the models, dashboards, and SLA tracking yourself rather than waiting for someone else to instrument it.

 - Comfort where the playbook doesn't exist, and a habit of leaving people better than you found them. You've stepped into situations with no established approach and built one, with the judgment to know when structure helps and when it would slow things down - and you've mentored program managers or been the person other teams borrow practices from.

 


EXPECTED SALARY RANGES

 - For candidates living in Ontario and British Columbia, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for this role is currently $102,000 - $132,000

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Thumbtack embraces diversity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, provincial, state, or local law. We also will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law.

Thumbtack is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a medical condition or disability during any part of the application process, please contact: recruitingops@thumbtack.com.

For information about how Thumbtack collects, uses, and shares personal information about job applicants, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Policy https://www.thumbtack.com/job-applicant-privacy-policy.

jobs.description:
THUMBTACK HELPS MILLIONS OF PEOPLE CONFIDENTLY CARE FOR THEIR HOMES.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.


ABOUT THE OFFICE OF THE CEO

The Office of the CEO works across Thumbtack’s most important company-wide priorities alongside the CEO, senior leadership team, and the leaders accountable for delivering them. It operates across organizational boundaries, with a close view of the strategy being set, the tradeoffs being made, and how decisions are being implemented. Deliberately small, the team creates leverage through judgment, access, and the ability to help the company move with greater clarity and speed.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As Chief of Staff to the CEO, you will be a second set of eyes on the whole business and close the gap between leadership decisions and organizational action. You will identify consequential questions, emerging risks, and conflicts across teams early, form a point of view, and ensure they are addressed by the right leaders. You will also help the company act on leadership decisions quickly, consistently, and with clear ownership. This is neither an administrative role nor the owner of company strategy; you will sharpen and pressure-test the senior leadership team’s direction while improving how the company acts on it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Translate senior leadership decisions into coordinated action by clarifying what was decided, identifying the teams affected, sequencing communication, and tracking execution.

 - Surface consequential questions, organizational constraints, and emerging risks early, and persist until the appropriate leaders address them.

 - Identify duplicated work, conflicting roadmaps, and cross-functional problems that lack clear ownership, then ensure they are resolved by the right teams.

 - Own and continually improve the senior leadership team’s operating rhythm, including how priorities are reviewed, decisions are made, and commitments are tracked.

 - Improve the quality and flow of information to and from the CEO so leaders have the context they need to act.

 - Lead a small number of CEO-priority efforts without a natural functional home, partnering with accountable leaders to move them through completion.

 


IN ORDER TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU MUST BRING

 - 12+ years of experience across operations, business operations, strategy, general management, or a chief of staff function in high-growth technology environments. Prior experience as a CEO’s chief of staff, leading an integration or organizational transformation, or scaling operations through a significant period of growth is a strong plus.

 - Evidence of entrepreneurial ownership, whether as a founder, early-stage operator, or internal builder who has led an ambiguous, high-stakes mandate from definition through execution.

 - A track record of driving complex, cross-functional initiatives to completion without relying on direct authority, title, or headcount.

 - The credibility, judgment, and low ego to operate as an intellectual peer to senior executives, form and press a clear point of view, challenge the CEO, and deliver difficult messages directly.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to compress complexity into clear, actionable direction quickly.

 - Exceptional organization, resilience, discretion, and follow-through, with the ability to create structure amid ambiguity and changing priorities.

 - Fluency using AI in your own work and a well-developed perspective on how AI should change the way a company like Thumbtack operates.

 


EXPECTED SALARY RANGES

 - For candidates living in Ontario and British Columbia, the expected salary range for the role is currently $232,000 - $284,000.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

jobs.description:
THUMBTACK HELPS MILLIONS OF PEOPLE CONFIDENTLY CARE FOR THEIR HOMES.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.


ABOUT THE COMMERCIAL STRATEGY TEAM

The Commercial Strategy team sits within the Business Development & Commercial Programs org and is responsible for helping take ideas from 0 to 1 by leading strategic initiatives and bets, and partnering cross functionally with other teams to test, experiment, and implement new strategies. In addition to driving new growth, the Commercial Strategy team owns and executes strategic growth programs that sit at the intersection of multiple teams and functions, and is the center of excellence for continuous improvement, focused on how to drive operational efficiency and rigor as we scale. The team goes where the problems are and are key to enabling future growth opportunities.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As Senior Commercial Strategy Manager, you will serve as a thought partner to leaders across the organization, lead critical cross-functional initiatives that shape the company’s growth trajectory, drive strategic planning cycles, stand up 0–1 initiatives, and unlock operational scale across our most critical programs.

Like most marketplaces, Thumbtack serves customers and pros, and this role creates value for both through our Partnerships business, one of Thumbtack’s fastest-growing segments. You will identify new growth opportunities, develop go-to-market strategies, launch programs that expand our marketplace’s reach through partners, and shape the strategy and direction of the organization.

Success in this fast-paced, fluid role requires strong problem-solving capabilities, analytical horsepower, comfort operating in ambiguity, and the ability to bring structure to chaos. Working closely with executives, product and engineering leaders, marketers, sales, and finance, you will bring strong business acumen, communication and collaboration skills, a self-starter mindset, and ownership of complex, high-priority problems from day one while pushing progress on multiple fronts.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Identify, prioritize and lead initiatives that support our biggest bets and create the greatest impact, while being agile and quickly pivoting as priorities change

 - Develop, test, and incubate new ideas (products and businesses)

 - Own ad hoc analysis and project work (e.g., board prep, planning, goal setting, competitive analysis, financial analyses)

 - Be the connective tissue across teams and functions, aligning stakeholders, harmonizing objectives, and driving progress; this role is extremely cross-functional

 - Be a leader who can see around corners, foresee roadblocks, and proactively propose solutions to overcome them - with minimal guidance

 - Be dynamic, resourceful, and willing to advocate for your projects internally and externally - influencing without authority will be critical to success

 - Be a trusted advisor to the Senior Director of Commercial Strategy, VP of Business Development, and Chief Commercial Officer

 


IN ORDER TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU MUST BRING

 - 5-7+ years in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, bizops, or strategy roles

 - A “super generalist” who is comfortable with ambiguity and building frameworks/plans to provide necessary structure

 - Ability to build analytical models and translate them into executive-level insights

 - Demonstrated ability to build strong cross functional relationships and influence leaders at all levels

 - Owner attitude and mentality that rolls up your sleeves to “Get Stuff Done”

 - Adept at influencing without authority and working with internal/external partners from all backgrounds

 - Growth mindset - you care about impact and going the extra mile
